env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^first 0 nil$'
stdout '^second 3 ok$'
stdout '^plain nil$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
# A bare-option nil comparison inside a comptime instance keeps its
# direct form; it must not become a negated inequality.
grep 'if rows == nil' out/main.go
! grep '!rows' out/main.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectctbarenil

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Row struct {
	N int
}

type DB struct{}

func (db *DB) Query(key string) (*Row?, error) {
	if key == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return &Row{N: 7}, nil
}

func (r *Row) State() string {
	return "ok"
}

func Get[T any](db *DB, key string, dflt T) (T, string) {
	rows, err := db.Query(key)
	if err != nil {
		var zero T
		return zero, "fail"
	}
	if rows == nil {
		var zero T
		return zero, "nil"
	}
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return dflt, "struct:" + rows.State()
	} else {
		return dflt, rows.State()
	}
}

func main() {
	db := &DB{}
	v, s := Get[int](db, "", 3)
	fmt.Println("first", v, s)
	v2, s2 := Get[int](db, "k", 3)
	fmt.Println("second", v2, s2)
	u, _ := db.Query("")
	if u == nil {
		fmt.Println("plain nil")
	}
}
